title: MVC-Bench: Benchmarking Calibration of Medical Vision-Language Models
reasons: 医学、生物医学或临床专题，超出当前 Agent 与通用模型评测方向
missingSignals: 材料中提供代码或数据链接（未核验内容）

evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: To this end, we propose MVC-Bench, a calibration-centric benchmark for medical image classification with VLMs and Medical-VLMs.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Collectively, MVC-Bench provides a structured evaluation framework and actionable guidance for improving calibration in safety-critical medical workflows.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: However, existing efforts mainly focused on improving accuracy, leaving calibration in the medical domain underexplored.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: It compares post-hoc calibration, train-time calibration, and zero-shot inference methods, together with six prompt-tuning methods.

evidence.label: 讨论泛化、污染、稳健性或人工核验
evidence.excerpt: MVC-Bench assesses the calibration across three axes: (i) robustness to modality, backbone, and domain shift (ii) effectiveness of calibration strategies and prompt-tuning methods (iii) stability under prompt-template and random-seed variations.
